title: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Amendment Order 1997

sections.shortTitle: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Amendment Order 1997
sections.section: ORDER - Salary of Judges of Superior Courts (Amendment) Order 1997
sections.description:
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 5 OF 1997
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 5 OF 1997
SALARY OF JUDGES OF SUPERIOR COURTS (AMENDMENT)
ORDER, 1997
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
28th May, 1997]
No. F.2(2)/97‑Pub., dated 28‑5‑1997.‑‑The
following Order made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further to amend the
Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order, 1995 (P.O. No.4 of 1995), for the
purposes hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the first paragraph of the Fifth
Schedule to the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan relating to
the Supreme Court and the High Courts provides that such higher salary than
that specified in the said paragraph shall be paid to a Judge of the Supreme
Court or a High Court as the President may from time to time determine;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers
conferred by the aforesaid paragraph, the President is pleased to snake the
following Order:‑‑
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑(1) This Order may be
called the Salary of Judges of Superior Courts (Amendment) Order, 1997.
(2) It shall
come into force at once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the first
day of June, 1995.
2. Amendment
of paragraph 2 of P.O. 4 of 1995.‑‑In the said Order, in
paragraph 2, in sub‑paragraph (2), for the figure "16976" the
figure "17100" shall be substituted.
